description: $0.05 USDC on Solana per started 1,000-step block (one run up to 1,000 steps = $0.05; NO $5 attestation rung exists) - the payment buys one signed subset-S reconciliation report for the submitted run: factors F1-F9, settlement-anchored vs operator-asserted figures under those exact labels, binding evidence per anchored step, and the coverage block verbatim. Totals are totals of the listed, bound, settled slice only.

run_id.description: The run key (no ':' characters - the memo form is colon-delimited).

settlements.description: Settlement records claimed as anchors: tx_signature, chain, run_id, task_key, memo_form, memo_expected, payer/payee wallets, amount_units.

steps.description: The run's step records (tool steps may carry settlement_ref; model steps are unpriced by the chain).

task_key.description: The task key the settlements are bound to.

name: subset_reconcile_reconcile
